steps.reason: Scope the full dataset before passing to downstream tools. No explicit date, amount, or account filters were given, so this loads all available transactions.
Compute per-account rolling features — especially rapid in->out ratio — needed to identify accounts that quickly pass funds along, a hallmark of round-tripping.
Core tool for this query: detects circular fund flows by finding short cycles and ring structures in the transaction network using networkx.
Apply the rapid_movement typology rule to flag accounts that rapidly move funds in and out, which commonly co-occurs with circular round-tripping patterns.
Run IsolationForest across the full population to surface anomalous accounts not caught by the graph or rules — round-tripping rings can involve subtle, low-volume flows that evade rule thresholds.
Combine graph cycle findings, rapid_movement rule hits, and anomaly scores into a unified LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH risk ranking for flagged accounts and entities.
